qualified_claims: In the tested actual RibaMod composition, fixed Ribasim allocation.dt boundaries that fall inside a BMI update_until interval are not executed merely because the interval crosses them.
With 6-hour product steps and allocation.dt=5 h, nominal fixed allocation boundaries at 5, 10, 15 and 20 h are absent from allocation output; only t=0 is solved during the first 24 h.
The misaligned A5 case therefore retains its initial 32/0 managed allocation throughout day 1 and exactly reproduces the previously qualified stale-allocation A24 product trajectory.
The aligned A6 control solves at every 6-hour call start and reproduces the qualified DUMMY-20D A6 trajectory.
Clock commensurability changes day-end UserDemand delivery by 8.4937483729 m3 under otherwise identical hydrology.

For this Ribasim v2026.1.1 BMI/RibaMod composition, effective fixed-allocation execution is constrained by coincidence between allocation boundaries and BMI call-start times; allocation.dt alone is not sufficient to guarantee execution of noncommensurate boundaries.

source_contract.ribasim_step: step! calls update_allocation! only when the current step-start time is an exact allocation multiple, then advances the full requested interval.
source_contract.allocation_callback: The inspected callback set contains no independent fixed-allocation callback.
source_contract.ribamod: RibaMod calls Ribasim update_until after each MF6 product step.

boundaries: This is a qualified runtime semantic finding, not an upstream defect classification.
Only the tested fixed-allocation v2026.1.1 BMI route and 6-hour RibaMod product cadence are covered.
No claim for adaptive allocation mode or later Ribasim releases.
No production SWAP5 admission or timestep prescription.
